test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘FLOWERY' is coded as 'FYREWOL' and ‘LINGUIST' is coded as ‘LTSIUGNI'. What is the code for 'MANIFEST' in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : All letters are written diagonally except first letter.

 
• First two letters interchange their positions.

So,

 
• ‘FLOWERY' is coded as 'FYREWOL'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48e13374f9d9898fc5723586ecf562951c1236e58cdc19e631b6daca6b22034c.png] 

And, 

 
• ‘LINGUIST' is coded as ‘LTSIUGNI'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9097f0c1cbbe2ef3729f0921f6987a0187ee4359d010c6621dc86e26b1eba4ec.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'MANIFEST' is coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecb43ad19785e4701d3492630bf2466eaa7c6d47c6566b220c37da2d969a5066.png] 

Hence, "**MTSEFINA**" is the correct answer.
